function EditorFooter(props) {
			const { t } = props;
			return (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
				className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["editorActions"],
				children: [(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("button", {
					type: "button",
					className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["secondaryButton"],
					disabled: props.busy,
					onClick: props.onCancel,
					children: t(props.cancelLabelKey ?? "cancel")
				}), (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("button", {
					type: "button",
					className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["primaryButton"],
					disabled: props.submitDisabled,
					onClick: props.onSubmit,
					children: props.busy ? t(props.submitBusyLabelKey) : t(props.submitLabelKey)
				})]
			});
		}
		//#endregion
		
const MULTI_KEY_ENTRY_ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,79}$/;
		const MULTI_KEY_REF = /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/;
		const MULTI_KEY_UNSAFE_IDS = new Set(["__proto__", "prototype", "constructor"]);
		function supportsMultiKeySchema(namespace, schema, path) {
			if (!namespace || !schema) return false;
			const root = schema.rehydrate(namespace.schema);
			const profile = schema.nodeAtPath(root, path);
			return profile?.dict?.multiKey !== void 0 && profile?.dict?.keyEntries !== void 0;
		}
		function multiKeyRef(route, id) {
			const normalized = route.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, "_");
			const stem = /^[A-Z_]/.test(normalized) ? normalized : `DSH_${normalized}`;
			return `${stem}_MULTKEY_${id.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, "_")}_API_KEY`;
		}
		function newMultiKeyEntry(route, source = {}) {
			const id = `k${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
			return [id, {
				name: source.name ?? "",
				...(typeof source.apiKeyEnv === "string" && source.apiKeyEnv.length > 0 ? { apiKeyEnv: source.apiKeyEnv } : {}),
				models: modelDrafts(source.models).map((model) => structuredClone(model))
			}];
		}
		function normalizedMultiKeyEntries(route, entries) {
			return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(entries).map(([id, entry]) => [id, {
				...entry,
				name: typeof entry?.name === "string" ? entry.name.trim() : "",
				apiKeyEnv: typeof entry?.apiKeyEnv === "string" && entry.apiKeyEnv.length > 0 ? entry.apiKeyEnv : multiKeyRef(route, id),
				models: modelDrafts(entry?.models).map((model) => structuredClone(model))
			}]));
		}
		function multiKeyFailure(route, entries, drafts, confirmations, t) {
			if (!entries || typeof entries !== "object" || Array.isArray(entries) || Object.keys(entries).length === 0) return t("multiKeyNeedsEntries");
			const refs = new Set();
			for (const [id, entry] of Object.entries(entries)) {
				if (!MULTI_KEY_ENTRY_ID.test(id) || MULTI_KEY_UNSAFE_IDS.has(id)) return t("multiKeyInvalidId");
				if (!entry || typeof entry.name !== "string" || entry.name.trim().length === 0 || entry.name.trim().length > 120) return t("multiKeyInvalidName");
				const ref = entry.apiKeyEnv ?? multiKeyRef(route, id);
				if (typeof ref !== "string" || !MULTI_KEY_REF.test(ref)) return t("multiKeyInvalidRef");
				if (refs.has(ref)) return t("multiKeyDuplicateRef");
				refs.add(ref);
				const keyFailure = apiKeyFailure(drafts[id] ?? "");
				if (keyFailure !== void 0) return `${entry.name}: ${t(keyFailure)}`;
				if ((drafts[id] ?? "").trim().length > 0 && ref !== multiKeyRef(route, id) && confirmations[id] !== true) return `${entry.name}: ${t("multiKeyConfirmRequired")}`;
				if (!Array.isArray(entry.models) || entry.models.length === 0) return `${entry.name}: ${t("multiKeyNeedsModels")}`;
				const modelFailure = validateDeepSeekModels(entry.models) ?? validateReasoningEfforts(entry.models);
				if (modelFailure !== void 0) return `${entry.name}: ${t("model")} ${String(modelFailure.index + 1)}: ${t(modelFailure.key)}`;
			}
		}
		async function storeMultiKeyDrafts(operations, entries, drafts, setDrafts) {
			for (const [id, entry] of Object.entries(entries)) {
				const draft = Object.hasOwn(drafts, id) ? drafts[id] : "";
				if (draft.trim().length === 0) continue;
				const failure = await operations.storeCredential(entry.apiKeyEnv, draft.trim());
				if (failure !== void 0) return failure;
				// Clear only successful, unchanged drafts: partial failures retry just
				// the unfinished credentials without rewriting the provider profile.
				setDrafts((current) => current[id] === draft ? { ...current, [id]: "" } : current);
			}
		}
		function hasMultiKeyDrafts(drafts) {
			return Object.values(drafts).some((value) => typeof value === "string" && value.length > 0);
		}
		function MultiKeyToggle({ t, checked, disabled, onChange, hasUnsavedKeys = false }) {
			const [confirmOff, setConfirmOff] = (0, react.useState)(false);
			(0, react.useEffect)(() => {
				if (!checked || disabled) setConfirmOff(false);
			}, [checked, disabled]);
			const close = () => setConfirmOff(false);
			return (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
				"data-multi-key-toggle": true,
				className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["field"],
				children: [(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
					className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["modelReasoningHead"],
					children: [(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["fieldLabel"], children: t("multiKey")
					}), (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(_deepseek_ai_dsh_client_ui_primitives.Switch, {
						checked, label: t("multiKey"), disabled,
						onChange: (enabled) => {
							if (disabled || enabled === checked) return;
							if (!enabled) setConfirmOff(true);
							else onChange(true);
						}
					})]
				}), (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("p", {
					className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["advancedHint"], children: t("multiKeyHelp")
				}), (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(_deepseek_ai_dsh_client_ui_primitives.Modal, {
					open: confirmOff && checked && !disabled, onClose: close,
					title: t(hasUnsavedKeys ? "multiKeyUnsavedTitle" : "multiKeyDisableTitle"),
					closeLabel: t("close"),
					description: t(hasUnsavedKeys ? "multiKeyUnsavedKeys" : "multiKeyDisableDescription"),
					className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["deleteDialog"],
					footer: (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)(react_jsx_runtime.Fragment, { children: [
						(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(_deepseek_ai_dsh_client_ui_primitives.Button, {
							variant: "outline", "data-modal-autofocus": true, onClick: close,
							children: t(hasUnsavedKeys ? "multiKeyReturnToEdit" : "multiKeyKeepEnabled")
						}), hasUnsavedKeys ? null : (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(_deepseek_ai_dsh_client_ui_primitives.Button, {
							variant: "outline", disabled,
							onClick: () => {
								if (disabled || !checked || hasUnsavedKeys) return;
								close(); onChange(false);
							}, children: t("multiKeyDisableConfirm")
						})
					] })
				})]
			});
		}
		function MultiKeyEntriesEditor(props) {
			const { route, entries, keyDrafts, confirmations, onChange, onKeyDraftsChange, onConfirmationsChange, operations, t, disabled } = props;
			const [busyEntries, setBusyEntries] = (0, react.useState)({});
			const anyBusy = Object.values(busyEntries).some(Boolean);
			const { onBusyChange } = props;
			(0, react.useEffect)(() => {
				onBusyChange?.(anyBusy);
			}, [anyBusy, onBusyChange]);
			(0, react.useEffect)(() => () => onBusyChange?.(false), [onBusyChange]);
			const update = (id, patch) => onChange({ ...entries, [id]: { ...entries[id], ...patch } });
			const remove = (id) => {
				const { [id]: removed, ...remaining } = entries;
				onChange(remaining);
				onKeyDraftsChange((current) => { const { [id]: removed, ...rest } = current; return rest; });
				onConfirmationsChange((current) => { const { [id]: removed, ...rest } = current; return rest; });
				setBusyEntries((current) => { const { [id]: removed, ...rest } = current; return rest; });
			};
			return (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
				"data-multi-key-entries": true,
				className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["modelList"],
				children: [Object.entries(entries).map(([id, candidate], index) => {
					const entry = candidate && typeof candidate === "object" && !Array.isArray(candidate) ? candidate : {};
					const ref = entry.apiKeyEnv ?? multiKeyRef(route, id);
					const draft = Object.hasOwn(keyDrafts, id) ? keyDrafts[id] : "";
					const keyFailure = apiKeyFailure(draft);
					const persisted = Object.hasOwn(props.persistedEntries ?? {}, id) && props.persistedEntries[id]?.apiKeyEnv === ref;
					const info = props.credentialChecks?.[ref];
					const status = info?.configured === true ? "multiKeyConfigured" : info?.configured === false ? "multiKeyMissing" : persisted ? "multiKeySaved" : "multiKeyNew";
					const needsConfirmation = draft.trim().length > 0 && ref !== multiKeyRef(route, id);
					const canUseStored = persisted && props.probe.provider !== void 0;
					const probe = {
						...props.probe,
						...(canUseStored ? { keyEntryId: id } : {}),
						...(draft.trim().length > 0 ? { apiKey: draft.trim() } : {})
					};
					const heading = typeof entry.name === "string" && entry.name.trim().length > 0 ? entry.name.trim() : `${t("multiKeyDefaultName")} ${String(index + 1)}`;
					return (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
						"data-key-entry-id": id, role: "group", "aria-label": heading,
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["rowCard"],
						style: { minWidth: 0 },
						children: [(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
							"data-key-entry-heading": true,
							className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["rowHead"],
							style: { flexWrap: "wrap" },
							children: [(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
								className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["rowName"],
								style: { minWidth: 0, overflowWrap: "anywhere", flex: "1 1 120px" }, children: heading
							}), (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("div", {
								className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["rowActions"],
								children: (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("button", {
									type: "button", className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["secondaryButton"], disabled,
									onClick: () => remove(id), children: t("multiKeyRemove")
								})
							})]
						}),
							(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("label", {
								className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["field"],
								children: [(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", { className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["fieldLabel"], children: t("multiKeyEntryName") }),
									(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("input", {
										className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["input"], type: "text", value: entry.name ?? "", maxLength: 120,
										"aria-label": `${t("multiKeyEntryName")} ${String(index + 1)}`, disabled,
										onChange: (event) => update(id, { name: event.target.value })
									})]
							}),
							(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
								className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["field"],
								children: [(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", { className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["fieldLabel"], children: t("keyInput") }),
									(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(ApiKeyInput, {
										t, value: draft, placeholder: t(persisted ? "keyPlaceholderSaved" : "keyPlaceholder"),
										"aria-label": `${t("keyInput")} ${String(index + 1)}`, "aria-invalid": keyFailure !== void 0,
										disabled: props.keyDisabled ?? disabled,
										onChange: (event) => {
											const value = event.target.value;
											onKeyDraftsChange((current) => ({ ...current, [id]: value }));
											onConfirmationsChange((current) => ({ ...current, [id]: false }));
										}
									}),
									(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("p", { className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["advancedHint"], children: t(status) }),
									(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("p", { className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["advancedHint"], style: { overflowWrap: "anywhere" }, children: t("multiKeyRef").replace("{ref}", () => ref) }),
									keyFailure === void 0 ? null : (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("p", { className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["error"], children: t(keyFailure) })]
							}),
							needsConfirmation ? (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("label", {
								className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["fieldLabel"],
								style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "flex-start", gap: 8, overflowWrap: "anywhere" },
								children: [(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("input", {
									type: "checkbox", "data-confirm-entry": id, "aria-label": t("multiKeyReplaceConfirm").replace("{ref}", () => ref),
									checked: confirmations[id] === true, disabled: props.keyDisabled ?? disabled,
									onChange: (event) => onConfirmationsChange((current) => ({ ...current, [id]: event.target.checked }))
								}), (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", { children: t("multiKeyReplaceConfirm").replace("{ref}", () => ref) })]
							}) : null,
							(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(ModelListEditor, {
								models: modelDrafts(entry.models), onChange: (models) => update(id, { models }),
								reasoningLevels: props.reasoningLevels, probe,
								probeBlocked: keyFailure ?? props.probeBlocked ?? (!canUseStored && draft.trim().length === 0 ? "multiKeyProbeNeedsKey" : void 0),
								operations, t, disabled,
								onBusyChange: (value) => setBusyEntries((current) => current[id] === value ? current : { ...current, [id]: value })
							})]
					}, id);
				}), (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("button", {
					type: "button", className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["addModelButton"], disabled,
					onClick: () => {
						let id, entry;
						do { [id, entry] = newMultiKeyEntry(route, { name: `${t("multiKeyDefaultName")} ${String(Object.keys(entries).length + 1)}` }); } while (Object.hasOwn(entries, id) || Object.values(entries).some((other) => other.apiKeyEnv === multiKeyRef(route, id)));
						onChange({ ...entries, [id]: entry });
					}, children: t("multiKeyAdd")
				}), (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("p", { className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["advancedHint"], children: t("multiKeyKeepCredentials") })]
			});
		}
		//#endregion

		
function CustomProviderCard(props) {
			const { taken, protocols, reasoningLevels, operations, t, onBusyChange } = props;
			const supportsMultiKey = supportsMultiKeySchema(props.namespace, props.schema, ["providers", PROBE_ROUTE]);
			const [openedAt] = (0, react.useState)(() => props.revision);
			const [route, setRoute] = (0, react.useState)("");
			const [displayName, setDisplayName] = (0, react.useState)("");
			const [baseURL, setBaseURL] = (0, react.useState)("");
			const [protocol, setProtocol] = (0, react.useState)(protocols[0] ?? "");
			const [keyDraft, setKeyDraft] = (0, react.useState)("");
			const [models, setModels] = (0, react.useState)([]);
			const [multiKey, setMultiKey] = (0, react.useState)(false);
			const [keyEntries, setKeyEntries] = (0, react.useState)({});
			const [entryKeyDrafts, setEntryKeyDrafts] = (0, react.useState)({});
			const [entryConfirmations, setEntryConfirmations] = (0, react.useState)({});
			const saving = (0, react.useRef)(false);
			const [busy, setBusy] = (0, react.useState)(false);
			const [listBusy, setListBusy] = (0, react.useState)(false);
			(0, react.useEffect)(() => {
				onBusyChange?.(busy || listBusy);
			}, [
				busy,
				listBusy,
				onBusyChange
			]);
			const [failure, setFailure] = (0, react.useState)(void 0);
			/**
			* The profile write landed. Only the key write can still be outstanding, so
			* the fields that describe the provider are settled and the retry path is
			* the credential alone.
			*/
			const [committed, setCommitted] = (0, react.useState)(false);
			const disabled = props.readOnly || busy;
			/** Everything but the key stops being editable once the provider exists. */
			const profileDisabled = disabled || committed;
			const routeInvalid = route.length > 0 && !ROUTE_PATTERN.test(route);
			const routeTaken = taken.includes(route);
			const normalizedBaseURL = baseURL.trim();
			const baseUrlInvalid = baseURL.length > 0 && !isHttpUrl(normalizedBaseURL);
			const modelFailure = multiKey ? void 0 : validateDeepSeekModels(models) ?? validateReasoningEfforts(models);
			const entryFailure = multiKey ? multiKeyFailure(route, keyEntries, entryKeyDrafts, entryConfirmations, t) : void 0;
			const keyFailure = multiKey ? void 0 : apiKeyFailure(keyDraft);
			const keyValue = keyDraft.trim();
			const ready = (committed || route.length > 0 && !routeInvalid && !routeTaken) && normalizedBaseURL.length > 0 && !baseUrlInvalid && (multiKey ? entryFailure === void 0 : models.length > 0 && modelFailure === void 0 && keyFailure === void 0);
			const hint = entryFailure ?? (failure !== void 0 || ready || keyFailure !== void 0 || route.length === 0 || routeInvalid || routeTaken || baseUrlInvalid ? void 0 : normalizedBaseURL.length === 0 ? t("customNeedsBaseUrl") : modelFailure !== void 0 ? `${t("model")} ${String(modelFailure.index + 1)}: ${t(modelFailure.key)}` : t("customNeedsModels"));
			/** Perform the create, returning a failure message or undefined. */
			const createOnce = async () => {
				const entries = normalizedMultiKeyEntries(route, keyEntries);
				const firstEntry = Object.values(entries)[0];
				const keyRef = multiKey ? firstEntry?.apiKeyEnv : deriveKeyRef(route);
				const storesKey = !multiKey && keyValue.length > 0;
				if (multiKey && entryFailure !== void 0) return entryFailure;
				if (!committed) {
					const profile = {
						...displayName.length === 0 ? {} : { displayName },
						...storesKey || multiKey ? { apiKeyEnv: keyRef } : {},
						api: protocol,
						baseURL: normalizedBaseURL,
						models: (multiKey ? firstEntry.models : models).map((model) => ({ ...model })),
						...(multiKey || Object.keys(keyEntries).length > 0 ? { multiKey, keyEntries: entries } : {})
					};
					const written = await operations.writeSettings(NS$1, [{
						op: "set",
						path: ["providers", route],
						value: profile
					}], openedAt);
					if (written.kind !== "written") return written.kind === "conflict" ? t("conflict") : written.message;
					setCommitted(true);
				}
				if (multiKey) return storeMultiKeyDrafts(operations, entries, entryKeyDrafts, setEntryKeyDrafts);
				if (storesKey) {
					const stored = await operations.storeCredential(keyRef, keyValue);
					if (stored !== void 0) return stored;
					setKeyDraft("");
				}
			};
			const create = async () => {
				if (saving.current || !ready || props.readOnly || listBusy) return;
				saving.current = true;
				setBusy(true);
				setFailure(void 0);
				try {
					const outcome = await createOnce();
					if (outcome !== void 0) {
						setFailure(outcome);
						return;
					}
					props.onClose(true);
				} catch {
					setFailure(t("multiKeySaveFailed"));
				} finally {
					saving.current = false;
					setBusy(false);
				}
			};
			return (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
				className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["editor"],
				children: [
					(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["field"],
						children: [(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
							className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["fieldLabel"],
							children: t("customRoute")
						}), (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("input", {
							className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["input"],
							type: "text",
							value: route,
							placeholder: "acme-gateway",
							"aria-label": t("customRoute"),
							disabled: profileDisabled,
							onChange: (event) => {
								setRoute(event.target.value);
							}
						})]
					}),
					routeInvalid || routeTaken ? (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("p", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["error"],
						children: t(routeInvalid ? "customRouteInvalid" : "customRouteTaken")
					}) : (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("p", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["advancedHint"],
						children: t("customRouteHint")
					}),
					(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["field"],
						children: [(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
							className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["fieldLabel"],
							children: t("customDisplayName")
						}), (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("input", {
							className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["input"],
							type: "text",
							value: displayName,
							placeholder: route.length === 0 ? t("customDisplayName") : route,
							"aria-label": t("customDisplayName"),
							disabled: profileDisabled,
							onChange: (event) => {
								setDisplayName(event.target.value);
							}
						})]
					}),
					(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["field"],
						children: [(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
							className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["fieldLabel"],
							children: t("baseUrl")
						}), (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("input", {
							className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["input"],
							type: "text",
							value: baseURL,
							placeholder: t(protocol === "anthropic-messages" ? "customAnthropicBaseUrlPlaceholder" : "customBaseUrlPlaceholder"),
							"aria-label": t("baseUrl"),
							"aria-invalid": baseUrlInvalid,
							disabled: profileDisabled,
							onChange: (event) => {
								setBaseURL(event.target.value);
							}
						})]
					}),
					baseUrlInvalid ? (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("p", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["error"],
						children: t("customBaseUrlInvalid")
					}) : null,
					(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["field"],
						children: [(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
							className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["fieldLabel"],
							children: t("customApi")
						}), (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("select", {
							className: `${ModelsSection_module_css_default["input"]} ${ModelsSection_module_css_default["selectInput"]}`,
							value: protocol,
							"aria-label": t("customApi"),
							disabled: profileDisabled,
							onChange: (event) => {
								setProtocol(event.target.value);
							},
							children: protocols.map((choice) => (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("option", {
								value: choice,
								children: protocolLabel(t, choice)
							}, choice))
						})]
					}),
					supportsMultiKey ? (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(MultiKeyToggle, {
						t, checked: multiKey, disabled: profileDisabled || listBusy, hasUnsavedKeys: hasMultiKeyDrafts(entryKeyDrafts),
						onChange: (enabled) => {
							if (enabled && Object.keys(keyEntries).length === 0) {
								const [id, entry] = newMultiKeyEntry(route, { name: displayName || route || t("multiKeyDefaultName"), models });
								setKeyEntries({ [id]: entry });
								if (keyDraft.length > 0) setEntryKeyDrafts({ [id]: keyDraft });
							}
							setMultiKey(enabled);
						}
					}) : null,
					multiKey ? (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(MultiKeyEntriesEditor, {
						route, entries: keyEntries, onChange: setKeyEntries,
						keyDrafts: entryKeyDrafts, onKeyDraftsChange: setEntryKeyDrafts,
						confirmations: entryConfirmations, onConfirmationsChange: setEntryConfirmations,
						persistedEntries: committed ? normalizedMultiKeyEntries(route, keyEntries) : {},
						probe: { settingsNs: NS$1, ...(committed ? { provider: route } : {}), baseURL: normalizedBaseURL, api: protocol },
						probeBlocked: baseUrlInvalid ? "customBaseUrlInvalid" : normalizedBaseURL.length === 0 ? "customNeedsBaseUrl" : void 0,
						reasoningLevels, operations, t, disabled: profileDisabled || listBusy, keyDisabled: disabled || listBusy, onBusyChange: setListBusy
					}) : null,
					multiKey ? null : (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["field"],
						children: [
							(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
								className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["fieldLabel"],
								children: t("keyInput")
							}),
							(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(ApiKeyInput, {
								t,
								value: keyDraft,
								placeholder: t("keyPlaceholder"),
								"aria-label": t("keyInput"),
								disabled,
								onChange: (event) => {
									setKeyDraft(event.target.value);
								}
							}),
							keyFailure === void 0 ? null : (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("p", {
								className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["error"],
								children: t(keyFailure === "keyBlank" ? "keyBlankNew" : keyFailure)
							})
						]
					}),
					!multiKey ? (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(ModelListEditor, {
						models,
						onChange: setModels,
						reasoningLevels,
						probe: {
							settingsNs: NS$1,
							baseURL: normalizedBaseURL,
							api: protocol,
							...keyValue.length === 0 ? {} : { apiKey: keyValue }
						},
						probeBlocked: baseUrlInvalid ? "customBaseUrlInvalid" : keyFailure === "keyBlank" ? "keyBlankNew" : keyFailure,
						operations,
						t,
						disabled: profileDisabled,
						onBusyChange: setListBusy
					}) : null,
					failure !== void 0 ? (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("p", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["error"],
						children: failure
					}) : null,
					hint === void 0 ? null : (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("p", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["advancedHint"],
						children: hint
					}),
					(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(EditorFooter, {
						t,
						busy,
						submitDisabled: disabled || listBusy || !ready,
						submitLabelKey: "create",
						submitBusyLabelKey: "creating",
						onCancel: () => {
							props.onClose(committed);
						},
						onSubmit: () => {
							create();
						}
					})
				]
			});
		}
		//#endregion
		//#region lib/types/client/ProviderEditor.js
		/**
		* One provider's editor card, hand-written per adapter family: the primary
		* field is a single write-only **API key** input (the page never asks for an
		* environment-variable name — a typed key stores through `credentials/set`
		* under the profile's reference, deriving `<ROUTE>_API_KEY` when the profile
		* has none. The pi-ai profile records that derivation as `apiKeyEnv` only when
		* a key is entered; a blank key materializes a reference-free profile for
		* provider-native authentication);
		* the collapsed 自定义设置 area carries the per-family extras (`baseURL` for
		* both families, DeepSeek's id/name/context-window model catalog, and the
		* display name and wire protocol of a pi-ai route the adapter does not ship —
		* the two fields the create card asked that route for, editable here for the
		* same reason).
		* Reasoning effort is deliberately absent: it is a per-MODEL capability, and
		* the models under one provider disagree about it, so a provider-scoped
		* control can only be set to a value some of them reject. The composer's
		* model picker offers each model its own levels; `cordis.patch.yml` keeps the
		* profile field for a deployment that knows its route. Everything else stays
		* owned by `cordis.patch.yml`. Profile edits land as minimal `settings.mutate`
		* path ops against the stored section — the card names only the fields it can
		* see instead of rebuilding the whole subtree from a partial descriptor.
		*/
		/** A user-section subtree as a plain draft object (absent → empty). */
		function draftAt(schema, namespace, path) {
			const subtree = schema.getPath(namespace.user, path);
			if (typeof subtree !== "object" || subtree === null || Array.isArray(subtree)) return {};
			return structuredClone(subtree);
		}
		/**
		* The minimal path ops carrying `after` over `before`, both as the card sees
		* them. Only keys the card observed are named; fields absent from both sides
		* produce no op, which is why edits are path-addressed rather than a rebuilt
		* section.
		* @param base - path of the edited subtree inside the user section.
		* @param before - the subtree as loaded, or undefined when it is new.
		* @param after - the subtree as edited.
		* @returns ordered set/unset ops; empty when nothing changed.
		*/
		function pathOps(base, before, after) {
			const previous = typeof before === "object" && before !== null && !Array.isArray(before) ? before : {};
			const ops = [];
			for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(after)) {
				if (JSON.stringify(previous[key]) === JSON.stringify(value)) continue;
				ops.push({
					op: "set",
					path: [...base, key],
					value
				});
			}
			for (const key of Object.keys(previous)) if (!(key in after)) ops.push({
				op: "unset",
				path: [...base, key]
			});
			return ops;
		}
		/** The editor layout the owning namespace selects. */
		function layoutOf(ns) {
			if (ns === "llm-deepseek") return "deepseek";
			if (ns === "llm-pi-ai") return "pi-ai";
			return "unknown";
		}
		/** The credential reference this profile resolves keys through. */
		function refFor(schema, namespace, path, provider) {
			const profile = schema.getPath(namespace.value, path);
			const named = typeof profile === "object" && profile !== null ? profile.apiKeyEnv : void 0;
			return typeof named === "string" && named.length > 0 ? named : deriveKeyRef(provider);
		}
		/**
		* Render one provider's editing card.
		* @param props - the addressed profile plus wire faces and copy.
		* @returns the editor card.
		*/
		function ProviderEditor(props) {
			const { namespace, schema, settingsPath, operations, t } = props;
			const [draft, setDraft] = (0, react.useState)(() => draftAt(schema, namespace, settingsPath));
			const [entryKeyDrafts, setEntryKeyDrafts] = (0, react.useState)({});
			const [entryConfirmations, setEntryConfirmations] = (0, react.useState)({});
			const saving = (0, react.useRef)(false);
			const [keyDraft, setKeyDraft] = (0, react.useState)("");
			const [busy, setBusy] = (0, react.useState)(false);
			const [listBusy, setListBusy] = (0, react.useState)(false);
			const { onBusyChange } = props;
			(0, react.useEffect)(() => {
				onBusyChange?.(busy || listBusy);
			}, [
				busy,
				listBusy,
				onBusyChange
			]);
			const [failure, setFailure] = (0, react.useState)(void 0);
			const [committedOriginal, setCommittedOriginal] = (0, react.useState)(() => schema.getPath(namespace.user, settingsPath));
			const [expectedRevision, setExpectedRevision] = (0, react.useState)(() => namespace.revision);
			const root = (0, react.useMemo)(() => schema.rehydrate(namespace.schema), [namespace.schema, schema]);
			const node = (0, react.useMemo)(() => schema.nodeAtPath(root, settingsPath), [
				root,
				schema,
				settingsPath
			]);
			const fallback = schema.getPath(namespace.value, settingsPath);
			const disabled = props.readOnly || busy;
			const layout = layoutOf(namespace.ns);
			const keyRef = refFor(schema, namespace, settingsPath, props.provider);
			const supportsMultiKey = layout === "pi-ai" && props.declared === true && props.credentialOnly !== true && supportsMultiKeySchema(namespace, schema, settingsPath);
			const multiKey = supportsMultiKey && (draft.multiKey ?? fallback?.multiKey) === true;
			const keyEntries = draft.keyEntries ?? fallback?.keyEntries ?? {};
			const entryFailure = multiKey ? multiKeyFailure(props.provider, keyEntries, entryKeyDrafts, entryConfirmations, t) : void 0;
			const protocols = (0, react.useMemo)(() => layout === "pi-ai" ? protocolChoices(namespace, schema) : [], [
				layout,
				namespace,
				schema
			]);
			const stringAt = (source, key) => {
				const value = schema.getPath(source, [key]);
				return typeof value === "string" && value.trim().length > 0 ? value : void 0;
			};
			const setField = (key, next) => {
				const value = next === void 0 || next.trim().length === 0 ? void 0 : next;
				setDraft((current) => value === void 0 ? schema.deletePath(current, [key]) : schema.setPath(current, [key], value));
			};
			const reasoningLevels = (0, react.useMemo)(() => layout === "pi-ai" && props.declared === true ? reasoningLevelChoices(namespace, schema) : [], [
				layout,
				props.declared,
				namespace,
				schema
			]);
			const editsReasoning = reasoningLevels.length > 0;
			const validateModels = (value) => validateDeepSeekModels(value) ?? (editsReasoning ? validateReasoningEfforts(value) : void 0);
			const modelFailure = multiKey ? void 0 : validateModels(schema.getPath(draft, ["models"]));
			const keyFailure = multiKey ? void 0 : apiKeyFailure(keyDraft);
			const keyValue = keyDraft.trim();
			const shownKeyFailure = (props.credentialRequired === true && keyDraft.length > 0 && keyValue.length === 0 ? "keyRequired" : void 0) ?? keyFailure;
			const probeApi = stringAt(draft, "api") ?? stringAt(fallback, "api");
			const probeBaseURL = stringAt(draft, "baseURL") ?? stringAt(fallback, "baseURL");
			const probe = {
				settingsNs: namespace.ns,
				provider: props.provider,
				...probeBaseURL === void 0 ? {} : { baseURL: probeBaseURL },
				...probeApi === void 0 ? {} : { api: probeApi },
				...keyValue.length === 0 ? {} : { apiKey: keyValue }
			};
			/**
			* The write for this card, or a failure message. Every edit travels as
			* path ops against the STORED section: the draft comes from the redacted
			* descriptor, so a wholesale replace rebuilt from it could delete fields
			* outside the card. Ops name only the fields this card can see.
			*/
			const applyOnce = async () => {
				const ns = namespace.ns;
				const normalizedDraft = supportsMultiKey && schema.hasPath(draft, ["keyEntries"]) ? schema.setPath(draft, ["keyEntries"], normalizedMultiKeyEntries(props.provider, keyEntries)) : draft;
				const next = multiKey ? schema.setPath(normalizedDraft, ["keyEntries"], normalizedMultiKeyEntries(props.provider, keyEntries)) : layout === "pi-ai" && stringAt(draft, "apiKeyEnv") === void 0 && stringAt(fallback, "apiKeyEnv") === void 0 && keyValue.length > 0 ? schema.setPath(normalizedDraft, ["apiKeyEnv"], keyRef) : normalizedDraft;
				if (entryFailure !== void 0) return entryFailure;
				if (props.credentialOnly !== true && !multiKey) {
					const failure = validateModels(schema.getPath(next, ["models"]));
					/* v8 ignore next 3 -- unreachable from the card: the same failure disables submit */
					if (failure !== void 0) return `${t("model")} ${String(failure.index + 1)}: ${t(failure.key)}`;
				}
				/* v8 ignore next -- apply is only reachable from the rendered card, which required a resolved node */
				if (props.credentialOnly !== true && node !== void 0 && settingsPath.length === 0) {
					const sectionError = schema.validate(node, next);
					if (sectionError !== void 0) return sectionError;
				}
				const materializesNativeProfile = layout === "pi-ai" && fallback === void 0 && committedOriginal === void 0 && Object.keys(next).length === 0;
				const ops = props.credentialOnly === true ? [] : materializesNativeProfile ? [{
					op: "set",
					path: [...settingsPath],
					value: {}
				}] : pathOps(settingsPath, committedOriginal, next);
				if (ops.length > 0) {
					const written = await operations.writeSettings(ns, ops, expectedRevision);
					if (written.kind !== "written") return written.kind === "conflict" ? t("conflict") : written.message;
					setCommittedOriginal(schema.getPath(written.view.user, settingsPath));
					setExpectedRevision(written.view.revision);
					setDraft(next);
				}
				if (multiKey) return storeMultiKeyDrafts(operations, next.keyEntries, entryKeyDrafts, setEntryKeyDrafts);
				if (keyValue.length > 0) {
					const stored = await operations.storeCredential(keyRef, keyValue);
					if (stored !== void 0) return stored;
				}
				setKeyDraft("");
			};
			const apply = async () => {
				if (saving.current || props.readOnly || listBusy || entryFailure !== void 0) return;
				saving.current = true;
				setBusy(true);
				setFailure(void 0);
				try {
					const failure = await applyOnce();
					if (failure !== void 0) {
						setFailure(failure);
						return;
					}
					props.onClose(true);
				} catch {
					setFailure(t("multiKeySaveFailed"));
				} finally {
					saving.current = false;
					setBusy(false);
				}
			};
			if (node === void 0) return (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("p", {
				className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["error"],
				children: [
					props.provider,
					": ",
					props.t("settingsPathUnresolvable")
				]
			});
			/**
			* The catalog beneath the user layer: what the composition entry pinned, or
			* else the schema default that `resolve` would supply. The effective value
			* cannot answer this — it still carries the stored override until the unset
			* is applied, so reading it would echo that override straight back the
			* moment reset drops it, leaving the rows unchanged until a reload.
			*/
			const inheritedModels = () => {
				return schema.getPath(namespace.base, [...settingsPath, "models"]) ?? schema.nodeAtPath(root, [...settingsPath, "models"])?.meta.default;
			};
			/**
			* The curated fields of one known adapter family. The family arrives
			* narrowed so the per-family branches below are total: an unknown namespace
			* renders the hint instead and never reaches this body.
			*/
			const curatedFields = (family) => {
				const ownsIdentity = family === "pi-ai" && props.declared === true;
				const customModels = schema.getPath(draft, ["models"]);
				const modelsOverridden = schema.hasPath(draft, ["models"]);
				const models = modelDrafts(modelsOverridden ? customModels : inheritedModels());
				const defaultContextWindow = schema.getPath(fallback, ["defaultContextWindow"]);
				const defaultMaxTokens = schema.getPath(fallback, ["maxTokens"]);
				const defaultInput = schema.getPath(fallback, ["defaultInput"]);
				const baseURL = stringAt(fallback, "baseURL") ?? props.defaultBaseURL;
				const endpointEnv = props.baseURLEnv ?? [];
				const endpointHint = family === "deepseek" ? t("deepSeekEndpointHint") : baseURL === void 0 && endpointEnv.length > 0 ? t("baseUrlEnvironment").replace("{env}", () => endpointEnv.join(", ")) : void 0;
				const namedRef = stringAt(fallback, "apiKeyEnv");
				const nativeAuth = namedRef === void 0 ? props.nativeAuth : void 0;
				const authRefs = namedRef === void 0 ? (nativeAuth?.env ?? []).filter((ref) => !endpointEnv.includes(ref)) : [namedRef];
				const visibleRefs = authRefs.filter((ref) => !ref.toLowerCase().includes("oauth"));
				const keyHint = visibleRefs[0];
				const checkedRefs = authRefs.map((ref) => [ref, props.credentialChecks?.[ref] ?? (ref === namedRef ? props.credential : void 0)]);
				const detected = checkedRefs.find(([, info]) => info?.configured === true);
				const detectedRef = detected?.[0];
				const detectedVisibleRef = detectedRef === void 0 || !visibleRefs.includes(detectedRef) ? void 0 : detectedRef;
				const missingRefs = checkedRefs.length > 0 && checkedRefs.every(([, info]) => info?.configured === false);
				const savedCredential = detected?.[1]?.source === "file";
				const credentialHint = keyDraft.length > 0 || savedCredential || keyHint === void 0 || props.credentialRequired === true ? void 0 : t(detectedRef === void 0 ? missingRefs ? "keyFallbackMissing" : "keyFallbackUnchecked" : detectedVisibleRef === void 0 ? "keyFallbackDetectedHidden" : "keyFallbackDetected").replace("{hint}", () => detectedVisibleRef ?? keyHint);
				const keyHelp = visibleRefs.length === 0 ? void 0 : t("keyHelp").replace("{env}", () => visibleRefs.join(" / "));
				const authHelp = keyHelp === void 0 ? null : (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(_deepseek_ai_dsh_client_ui_primitives.Tooltip, {
					label: keyHelp,
					side: "right",
					delayMs: 0,
					focusDelayMs: 0,
					portal: true,
					openOnClick: true,
					children: (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("button", {
						type: "button",
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["helpButton"],
						"aria-label": t("authHelp"),
						children: "?"
					})
				});
				const keylessNativeAuth = nativeAuth?.env.length === 0 && nativeAuth.oauth;
				const keyPlaceholder = keyHint === void 0 || props.credentialRequired === true ? t("keyPlaceholder") : t(savedCredential ? "keyPlaceholderSaved" : "keyPlaceholderFallback").replace("{hint}", () => keyHint);
				/** What both family editors take: the rows, whose layer owns them, and the two writes. */
				const catalogProps = {
					models,
					overridden: modelsOverridden,
					t,
					disabled,
					onChange: (next) => {
						setDraft((current) => schema.setPath(current, ["models"], next));
					},
					onReset: () => {
						setDraft((current) => schema.deletePath(current, ["models"]));
					}
				};
				const credentials = (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)(react_jsx_runtime.Fragment, { children: [supportsMultiKey ? (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(MultiKeyToggle, {
					t, checked: multiKey, disabled: disabled || listBusy, hasUnsavedKeys: hasMultiKeyDrafts(entryKeyDrafts),
					onChange: (enabled) => {
						let updated = schema.setPath(draft, ["multiKey"], enabled);
						if (enabled && Object.keys(keyEntries).length === 0) {
							const namedRef = stringAt(draft, "apiKeyEnv") ?? stringAt(fallback, "apiKeyEnv");
							const [id, entry] = newMultiKeyEntry(props.provider, {
								name: stringAt(draft, "displayName") ?? stringAt(fallback, "displayName") ?? props.displayName ?? props.provider,
								apiKeyEnv: namedRef,
								models: draft.models ?? fallback?.models ?? inheritedModels()
							});
							if (keyDraft.length > 0) {
								setEntryKeyDrafts({ [id]: keyDraft });
								if (namedRef === void 0) updated = schema.setPath(updated, ["apiKeyEnv"], multiKeyRef(props.provider, id));
							}
							updated = schema.setPath(updated, ["keyEntries"], { [id]: entry });
						}
						setDraft(updated);
					}
				}) : null, multiKey ? (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(MultiKeyEntriesEditor, {
					route: props.provider, entries: keyEntries,
					onChange: (entries) => setDraft((current) => schema.setPath(current, ["keyEntries"], entries)),
					keyDrafts: entryKeyDrafts, onKeyDraftsChange: setEntryKeyDrafts,
					confirmations: entryConfirmations, onConfirmationsChange: setEntryConfirmations,
					persistedEntries: schema.getPath(committedOriginal, ["keyEntries"]) ?? fallback?.keyEntries ?? {},
					credentialChecks: props.credentialChecks,
					probe: { settingsNs: namespace.ns, provider: props.provider, ...(probeBaseURL === void 0 ? {} : { baseURL: probeBaseURL }), ...(probeApi === void 0 ? {} : { api: probeApi }) },
					reasoningLevels, operations, t, disabled: disabled || listBusy, onBusyChange: setListBusy
				}) : null, multiKey || keylessNativeAuth ? null : (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
					className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["field"],
					children: [
						(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("span", {
							className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["fieldLabel"],
							children: [t("keyInput"), authHelp]
						}),
						(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(ApiKeyInput, {
							t,
							value: keyDraft,
							placeholder: keyPlaceholder,
							"aria-label": t("keyInput"),
							"aria-invalid": shownKeyFailure !== void 0,
							"aria-describedby": credentialHint === void 0 ? void 0 : `${props.provider}-credential-hint`,
							required: props.credentialRequired === true,
							autoFocus: props.autoFocusCredential === true,
							disabled,
							onChange: (event) => {
								setKeyDraft(event.target.value);
							}
						}),
						credentialHint === void 0 ? null : (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("p", {
							id: `${props.provider}-credential-hint`,
							className: ModelsSection_module_css_default[missingRefs ? "notice" : detectedRef === void 0 ? "advancedHint" : "savedNotice"],
							children: credentialHint
						}),
						shownKeyFailure === void 0 ? null : (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("p", {
							className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["error"],
							children: t(shownKeyFailure)
						})
					]
				})] });
				const customization = props.credentialOnly === true ? null : (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("details", {
					className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["customized"],
					open: supportsMultiKey ? true : void 0,
					"data-multi-key-shared-settings": supportsMultiKey ? true : void 0,
					children: [(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("summary", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["customizedSummary"],
						children: t(supportsMultiKey ? "multiKeySharedSettings" : "customized")
					}), (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["customizedBody"],
						children: [
							ownsIdentity ? (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
								className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["field"],
								children: [(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
									className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["fieldLabel"],
									children: t("customDisplayName")
								}), (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("input", {
									className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["input"],
									type: "text",
									value: stringAt(draft, "displayName") ?? "",
									placeholder: stringAt(schema.getPath(namespace.base, settingsPath), "displayName") ?? props.provider,
									"aria-label": t("customDisplayName"),
									disabled,
									onChange: (event) => {
										setField("displayName", event.target.value);
									}
								})]
							}) : null,
							(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
								className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["field"],
								children: [
									(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
										className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["fieldLabel"],
										children: t("baseUrl")
									}),
									(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("input", {
										className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["input"],
										type: "text",
										value: stringAt(draft, "baseURL") ?? "",
										placeholder: family === "deepseek" ? t("deepSeekBaseUrl") : baseURL === void 0 ? t(endpointEnv.length > 0 ? "baseUrlConfigured" : "baseUrlDefault") : t("baseUrlPlaceholder").replace("{url}", () => baseURL),
										"aria-describedby": endpointHint === void 0 ? void 0 : `${props.provider}-endpoint-hint`,
										"aria-label": t("baseUrl"),
										disabled,
										onChange: (event) => {
											setField("baseURL", event.target.value === "" ? void 0 : event.target.value);
										}
									}),
									endpointHint === void 0 ? null : (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
										id: `${props.provider}-endpoint-hint`,
										className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["advancedHint"],
										children: endpointHint
									})
								]
							}),
							ownsIdentity ? (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
								className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["field"],
								children: [(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
									className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["fieldLabel"],
									children: t("customApi")
								}), (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("select", {
									className: `${ModelsSection_module_css_default["input"]} ${ModelsSection_module_css_default["selectInput"]}`,
									value: probeApi ?? "",
									"aria-label": t("customApi"),
									disabled,
									onChange: (event) => {
										setField("api", event.target.value);
									},
									children: [probeApi === void 0 ? (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("option", {
										value: "",
										children: t("customApiUnset")
									}) : null, protocols.map((choice) => (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("option", {
										value: choice,
										children: protocolLabel(t, choice)
									}, choice))]
								})]
							}) : null,
							multiKey ? null : family === "deepseek" ? (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(DeepSeekModelsEditor, {
								...catalogProps,
								defaultContextWindow: typeof defaultContextWindow === "number" ? defaultContextWindow : void 0,
								defaultMaxTokens: typeof defaultMaxTokens === "number" ? defaultMaxTokens : void 0
							}) : (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(ModelListEditor, {
								...catalogProps,
								catalogProvider: props.declared === true ? void 0 : props.provider,
								reasoningLevels,
								defaultInput: Array.isArray(defaultInput) ? defaultInput : void 0,
								probe,
								probeBlocked: keyFailure,
								operations,
								onBusyChange: setListBusy
							})
						]
					})]
				});
				return (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)(react_jsx_runtime.Fragment, { children: supportsMultiKey ? [customization, credentials] : [credentials, customization] });
			};
			return (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
				className: props.credentialOnly === true ? ModelsSection_module_css_default["addBlock"] : ModelsSection_module_css_default["editor"],
				children: [
					props.hideTitle === true ? null : (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["editorHeader"],
						children: [(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
							className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["editorTitle"],
							children: props.displayName
						}), props.provider !== props.displayName ? (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
							className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["editorRoute"],
							children: props.provider
						}) : null]
					}),
					layout === "unknown" ? (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("p", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["advancedHint"],
						children: `${t("advancedHint")} (${namespace.ns})`
					}) : curatedFields(layout),
					(failure ?? entryFailure) !== void 0 ? (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("p", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["error"],
						children: failure ?? entryFailure
					}) : null,
					props.credentialOnly === true || modelFailure === void 0 ? null : (0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)("p", {
						className: ModelsSection_module_css_default["advancedHint"],
						children: `${t("model")} ${String(modelFailure.index + 1)}: ${t(modelFailure.key)}`
					}),
					(0, react_jsx_runtime.jsx)(EditorFooter, {
						t,
						busy,
						submitDisabled: disabled || listBusy || layout === "unknown" || entryFailure !== void 0 || props.credentialOnly !== true && modelFailure !== void 0 || !multiKey && (shownKeyFailure !== void 0 || props.credentialRequired === true && keyValue.length === 0),
						submitLabelKey: props.submitLabelKey ?? "apply",
						submitBusyLabelKey: props.submitBusyLabelKey ?? "applying",
						...props.cancelLabelKey === void 0 ? {} : { cancelLabelKey: props.cancelLabelKey },
						onCancel: () => {
							props.onClose(false);
						},
						onSubmit: () => {
							props.onSubmitCredential?.();
							apply();
						}
					})
				]
			});
		}
		//#endregion
